labels.label: risk
labels.reason: States a dump/restore, pg_upgrade, or logical replication is required to migrate data from any previous release, which is mandatory migration work.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: User-defined aggregates and operators referencing the changed array function signatures must be dropped before upgrade and recreated afterward.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes the @ and ~ containment operators for geometric types and cube, hstore, intarray, and seg, so queries using them will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Changes the tsquery output of to_tsquery() and websearch_to_tsquery() for text with discarded tokens, which can alter search results.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Changes websearch_to_tsquery() output for quoted text with adjacent discarded tokens, altering phrase-search behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: EXTRACT() now returns numeric instead of float8 and EXTRACT(date) errors for non-date units, which can break applications.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: var_samp() and stddev_samp() now return NULL instead of NaN for a single NaN input, a visible result change.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: has_column_privilege() now returns false instead of raising an error for invalid attribute numbers, changing behavior that code may depend on.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Window frame behavior with infinite ranges changes, so results differ from before for affected queries.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes the factorial operators ! and !! and numeric_fac(), so existing queries using them will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: factorial() of negative numbers is now disallowed and raises an error where it previously returned 1.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes support for postfix operators, so user-defined postfix operators and queries using them will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: \D and \W now match newlines in newline-sensitive mode, changing regex results; old behavior needs rewriting.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Changes how constraints are applied when matching regex back-references, which can change match results.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Regular expressions using \w as a character class range endpoint are now disallowed and will error.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Custom server parameter names must now use only valid unquoted identifier characters, which could break existing configs.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Default password_encryption changes to scram-sha-256, affecting client compatibility, and legacy boolean-like values are no longer accepted.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes the vacuum_cleanup_index_scale_factor parameter, so configs that set it may cause startup errors.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removes the operator_precedence_warning parameter, so configs that set it will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: pg_hba.conf clientcert values 1/0/no-verify are no longer supported and verify-ca is disallowed with cert auth, requiring config changes.
